fields.description: Rated machine input voltage; conflicting regional observations are not configurations.
Explicitly rated discrete supply frequencies; do not expand a printed range into a list without Technical confirmation.
Rated primary drive motor output; input consumption and auxiliary motor power are different facts. Preserve horsepower standard uncertainty before conversion.
Rated primary motor shaft speed; does not represent tool operating speed.
Minimum supported wheel operating speed for the approved current machine configuration.
Maximum supported wheel operating speed; cannot inherit flex-shaft speed.
Minimum flex-shaft operating speed; attachment-specific EM-1 control range.
Maximum flex-shaft operating speed; never a motor or wheel speed alias.
Minimum supported blade diameter; range endpoints require an approved mounting specification.
Maximum supported blade diameter; does not independently prove compatibility.
Nominal supported arbor wheel diameter; does not identify included wheel products.
Blade mounting arbor diameter; excludes wheel mounting and threaded attachments.
Wheel mounting arbor diameter; other mount geometries require separate evidence.
Water reservoir nominal capacity; Technical must confirm US versus Imperial gallon before approval.
Minimum operating cutting-oil fill; not nominal tank or water capacity.
Maximum operating cutting-oil fill; preserve gallon-system ambiguity.
Governed water system arrangement: recirculating_filtered is evidenced by the EM-1 filtration system; no default for other machines.
Durable net machine weight without shipping packaging, fluid fill and installed accessories explicitly declared.
Assembled machine length; axis orientation and included assemblies must be approved from the drawing.
Assembled machine width; axis orientation and included assemblies must be approved from the drawing.
Assembled machine height; axis orientation and included assemblies must be approved from the drawing.
Outer standard shipping crate length; includes packing allowances and must have an Operations-approved packing revision.
Outer standard shipping crate width; includes packing allowances and must have an Operations-approved packing revision.
Outer standard shipping crate height; includes packing allowances and must have an Operations-approved packing revision.
Dependent Product to exact compatible machine Product references; only universally applicable approved Product edges.
Exact catalog Products included in the current commercial machine package; independent from fit and recommendations.
Positive integer quantity map keyed by exactly the GIDs in included_products; companion metadata, never independent membership.
Product-local component lines with label, positive integer quantity and included/not_included/optional meaning for evidenced noncatalog contents.
Separately selectable optional catalog components confirmed by Technical and Product Owner; not speculative machine Variants.
Product Owner merchandising recommendations; cannot establish compatibility or box contents.

factPolicy.authority: E-PBI-001 source hierarchy; current engineering source plus Technical approval. Description HTML is lower-authority candidate evidence.
factPolicy.conflicting: preserve all original observations and conflict IDs; never serialize an approved value
factPolicy.variantScope: requires exact current Variant GID and approved E-PBI-008 commerce distinction; no current machine Variant technical definitions
factPolicy.range: endpoints must share source, configuration, physical state and unit; minimum <= maximum
factPolicy.unitConversion: Retain source value/unit. Require confirmed US/Imperial gallons and horsepower standard before conversion; canonical formatting is never customer display text.

compatibility.variantException: A Product assertion means all purchased variants fit. Saw Blade Size-specific evidence stays Variant-scoped in repository; no Product union and no Variant definition until exact fit is proven.
compatibility.unknown: No evidence is blocked/unknown, never not_compatible.
compatibility.negative: not_compatible requires explicit negative evidence and owner approval; never serialize negative edges as positive references.
compatibility.successor: An exact approved successor mapping does not inherit fit. Reapprove each replacement edge with provenance.
compatibility.orphans: Missing target blocks publication and later population; preserve historical GID and source.
compatibility.unpublished: Retain support evidence but suppress customer links; do not redirect to an inferred successor.
compatibility.duplicates: Reject self references, duplicate scoped edges and machine-to-machine canonical fit.
compatibility.reverse: Derive only approved positive edges, sorted by target GID then dependent GID; no stored reciprocal copy.

packageRecordShape.dimensions: typed positive dimension; outer package axes
packageRecordShape.count: positive integer equal to records.length when count approved
packageRecordShape.weight: no duplicate canonical package shipping weight; source observations only

measurements.multiPackagePolicy: No records without explicit package identity/count evidence. A singular crate heading does not prove package count. Actual order packing may differ and must not overwrite durable product facts.

components.membership: Catalog membership uses native Product reference lists; included_quantities is an exact-GID keyed positive integer companion map, not a second membership authority.
components.noncatalog: Product-local JSON lines {label, quantity, meaning}; justified by counted EM-1 tools and explicit battery exclusion. Not a reusable component entity; never create placeholder Products/metaobjects.
components.approval: Technical and Product Owner approve included/excluded/optional truth; Product Owner approves recommendations separately.
components.optionalConfiguration: Unproven options such as C-018 remain repository evidence; do not create variants.
components.compatibility: Never derive inclusion or recommendations from fit, or fit from inclusion/recommendations.

resources.metadataStorage: Governed repository resource catalog keyed by sourceId and existing File GID. Native Files own binary identity; no duplicate canonical URL or new metaobject is needed.
resources.currentGate: Exact applicable Product, owner decision, rights/publication approval, version/language review and current status required. No newest-filename/upload-date heuristic.
resources.supportOnly: support_files access is Admin only; other references admit only approved customer-visible current resources.
resources.supersession: Preserve predecessor sourceId/File GID; require explicit successor link and prohibit cycles.
resources.duplicates: Exact hash groups are binary evidence, not canonical-version approval; probable video groups remain unconfirmed.
resources.notInScope: Warranty, repair promises and service contracts remain E-PBI-016.
